description.text: Generated by fixtures/accelerators/scrape.py from the official page retrieved on 2026-11-14. It repeats that page's visible text and adds nothing to it: Olean Business Development Corporation | Supporting business | 301 N. Union Street Olean, NY 14760 4th Floor | Suite 401 top of page Home About Us Laine Place Our Programs and Services Blog Contact Donate Olean Business Development Corporation Propelling Business and Community Development in the Greater Olean Area Contact Us 400+ Companies Served 10+ Years of Experience 100+ Programs Deployed Who We Are Olean Business Development Corporation (OBDC) is a 501(c)(3) not-for-profit dedicated to the continued development of the Entrepreneurial Ecosystem in the greater Olean area. OBDC strives to help entrepreneurs and small business owners throughout their business journey, from startup to transition, by deploying programming, establishing connections to other support organizations that OBDC partners with, and continuous contact with these business owners. Our Impact Our small town is full of big ideas, driven by amazing entrepreneurs and small business owners. Our programs and services have led to over 100 jobs being created in the Olean region, with increased revenue for these business owners, maintaining this impactful small business footprint in our region, and keeping these much-needed services in our communities.
